title: Rollout Composer — Cost-aware Permission Change + Audit Snapshot Preview (prototype)
creator: Maya Patel
description: Design a compact Rollout Composer UI that lets admins stage permission changes for a workspace or org, preview the access delta, estimate incremental cost impact, and capture an immutable audit snapshot to attach to the rollout. The flow should support canary/cascade rollout policies, show a per-user/per-role access preview, and provide a single-click rollback marker that ties back to the audit timeline. This ticket covers hi-fi interactive prototypes, accessibility pass, and a short usability review with PM/engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive prototype demonstrates: select target scope (org/workspace/team), choose permission delta, configure canary percentage and duration, and start staged rollout.
Preview panel shows number of affected principals, representative user examples, and a cost delta estimate (tokens and compute cost approximation) per day/week at expected traffic profiles.
Audit snapshot created at start of rollout: immutable record with diff view, timestamp, author, and optional note. Snapshot appears in Audit Log and Rollout history.
Rollout Composer includes 'simulate impact' mode that highlights user-facing changes and surfaces high-risk principals (service-accounts, high-activity users) with warnings.
Accessibility: keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels for major controls, 4.5:1 contrast for key actionable elements.
Design handoff assets (Figma, interaction spec) and a short design QA checklist delivered to engineering before implementation.
Prototype tested with 3 PMs/engineers and synthesis notes captured in comments.
design_notes: We explored two main layouts for the preview panel: a split list + map of affected users versus a compact heatstrip that aggregates by role and frequency. The heatstrip was chosen for initial prototype to conserve vertical real-estate on workspace pages.

Cost estimates map to existing Optimize heuristics: uses a conservative per-token baseline for generation traffic and a compute multiplier for active inference paths (streaming vs batch). We explicitly surface uncertainty ranges (+/- 20%).

High-risk detection rules: flagged if change affects 'owner' role, service accounts with >100k tokens/month, or principals with active dedicated sessions. These rules are pluggable—ENG will provide final signal set.
Audit snapshot is intentionally minimal (diff + metadata + optional note) to reduce noise in Audit Log. We add a 'View full context' link to the Rollout history for deep inspection.
We included a tiny inline explainer that shows previous rollouts and their outcomes (success, partial rollback) to help admins decide canary sizes.
Rollout Composer will autosave draft changes and allow export of snapshot JSON for compliance teams.
open_questions: Should cost delta calculation be shown for 'hosted' vs 'dedicated' buckets separately? (PM leaning: yes, show both with clear labels).
How granular should the 'simulate impact' examples be? Per-role only or representative user rows? (Design prefers representative rows + role aggregate.)
Do we allow editing a live rollout's canary percentage mid-flight from the Composer UI or redirect users to a specialized Rollout Manager page?
What telemetry/metrics does Eng need to record rollout acceptance? (Propose: #affected_principals, expected_cost_delta, canary_success_rate)
Legal: attaching audit snapshot to external compliance exports — does this require additional encryption/access controls?
stakeholder_feedback: PM (Ana R.) - Likes quick cost delta and wants a toggle to only surface 'high-impact' principals.
Eng (Rohit K.) - Requests machine-readable snapshot JSON structure and clear versioning for snapshots so rollbacks can be automated.
Security (Derek S.) - Wants snapshot writes to be separately permissioned; recommends 'create-audit-snapshot' permission instead of auto-attach for all rollout actors.
Support (Lena M.) - Suggests an optional 'explain to users' template that can be included in the rollout note to reduce support load.
Legal (Priya T.) - Flags potential PII exposure in representative user rows; requests anonymized examples unless explicit export consent.
accessibility_considerations: All interactive controls must have aria-labels and visible focus states.
Heatstrip legend must be accessible to colorblind users and provide text alternatives.
Contrast checks completed for prototype buttons and warning chips.
Prototype includes keyboard-first flow for power-users (tab order documented in handoff spec).
implementation_notes: Frontend: Compose UI as a modal anchored from Workspace Settings > Roles. Modal stepper: Scope -> Changes -> Preview & Cost -> Canary -> Review & Snapshot.

Backend: API endpoints to calculate impact preview and cost delta will be under /api/internal/rollouts/preview and must accept synthetic traffic profiles. Cache preview responses for 30s to avoid flapping costs.
Audit: snapshots are stored in immutable audit-index with an id returned to the Composer for linking. Snapshot write must be idempotent.
Metrics: add rollout_started, rollout_snapshot_created, rollout_rolled_back events to telemetry with rollout_id.
Security: restrict snapshot creation to users with permission to 'create_audit_snapshot'; require SSO auth for export endpoints.
Handoff: include interaction map, annotated Figma with token-level motion specs, and final component props table.
